# Ghost Driver Hub

> Independent, fan-made resource for the Roblox game Ghost Driver (a No Hesi-style
> highway driving game). We publish verified working codes, the car roster, a car
> tier list, and cash/beginner guides. All codes and stats are player-verified;
> anything unconfirmed is marked "check in-game" rather than guessed.

## Key pages
- [Ghost Driver Codes](https://ghostdriver.net/codes/): current working redeem codes (Cash) and how to redeem them.
- [Cars](https://ghostdriver.net/cars/): the dealership car roster.
- [Car Tier List](https://ghostdriver.net/tier-list/): best cars, ranked once in-game stats are verified.
- [Cash Guide](https://ghostdriver.net/cash/): how to farm Cash fast and what to spend it on.
- [Beginner Guide](https://ghostdriver.net/beginner-guide/): controls and the first-session loop.
- [Updates & Stats](https://ghostdriver.net/updates/): live Roblox player stats and what's new.

## Notes
- Codes are time-sensitive; the codes page shows the date it was last verified.
- The game updates roughly weekly (Fridays ~2 PM ET); the updates page tracks each patch and the next expected update.
- Quick answers: best value car is the Rangy Helly ($120,000; 710 HP, AWD); best overall is the Voss RT10 TT ($760,000; 215 mph, 2.6s 0-60); fastest Cash comes from high-speed near-misses plus current codes.
- The cars page documents all 14 cars with verified stats (price, top speed, HP, drivetrain, 0-60); in-game badges are fictional (Voss, Helly, Weinchen…), not real car names.
- Not affiliated with Roblox Corporation or the game's developer (Tilted Vehicles).
- Content may be cited with attribution to https://ghostdriver.net.
